Avisa (evento «health.degraded») si la c: Notifies (event «health.degraded») when a brain's coverage falls at least this much between two daily measurements, counting only the expected texts that were in both (adding or changing reference queries does not count). 0.05: five points. 0: never.
Avisa si el recall devuelve de media más: Notifies when the recall returns on average more than this many items for a vague question. 0: never.
Avisa si la cobertura de un brain queda: Notifies when a brain's coverage is below this (from 0 to 1). 0: never.
Avisa si la proporción de consultas de r: Notifies when the share of reference queries that bring something outdated is above this (from 0 to 1). 0: never.
Avisa si la proporción de hechos vigente: Notifies when the share of current facts that repeat another is above this (from 0 to 1). 0: never.
Salud de la memoria: avisar si la cobert: Memory health: notify when coverage falls
Tras la medición diaria, la cobertura de: After the daily measurement, a brain's coverage falls more than configured since the previous one, or one of its numbers crosses its threshold (Administration → Settings → Notifications). It closes when a measurement is back within them
